description: This file defines the LoggerChannel class in Drupal, implementing logging functionality with support for request context, user info, and log level translation.

classes.name: LoggerChannel
classes.description: Implements a logging channel for Drupal, supporting multiple loggers, context enrichment, and recursion control.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the LoggerChannel with a specified channel name.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs a message at a specified level, enriching context with request and user info, and managing recursion depth.

methods.name: setRequestStack
methods.description: Sets the request stack object for obtaining request context.

methods.name: setCurrentUser
methods.description: Sets the current user object for including user info in logs.

methods.name: setLoggers
methods.description: Assigns an array of loggers to the channel.

methods.name: addLogger
methods.description: Adds a logger with an optional priority to the channel.

methods.name: sortLoggers
methods.description: Sorts and returns loggers based on priority.
